body.summary: Draft for Supervisor review: the snapshot documents approved and locally tested readiness work, but does not establish a completed cloud run, accepted output, recurring cutover, or a fully laptop-independent HQ. The record is a dated setup snapshot; subsequent live state is unverified. [docs/hq/cloud/LIVE_SETUP_RECORD.md@sha256:bf54babc08b09a465e70d008d099cb0de42afb09a9cbf2714ae13b4bf29add2d]
questions: Has the outstanding API key handoff occurred, and what authenticated evidence shows its scope and storage?
Has one bounded cloud run completed with the required immutable source-linked draft, token usage, cost reservation, Postgres save, review stop, and authenticated-owner readback?
Has an independent source review occurred, and was any output accepted by the Supervisor?
What evidence establishes the current Railway hosting/payment state, given that the paid $10 hosting cap was unverified and the trial was recorded?
Has the funding record been rechecked before any further paid dispatch, given its 1 October 2026 expiry?
What evidence, if any, supports recurrence or cutover of the six desktop schedules?
Are the apparent differences between the OpenAI billing readback and the initial $5 top-up request reconciled in the current live billing record?
Has any canonical memory promotion, external send, publication, production change, or customer-data processing occurred? If so, where are the required approval and execution records?

observations.statement: The constitution and Institutional Memory charter define bounded Green work through existing desktop schedules; new mandate timers remain disabled and no consequential permission is granted. [Implemented/configured in the snapshot; current live state not established.]

Oday approval for the bounded $20/month pilot is recorded, with a $10 hosting, $8 API, and $2 contingency envelope; this does not authorize unrelated spend, sends, sensitive publication, production changes, customer-data import, or automatic canonical promotion. [Approval recorded; execution and payment state require separate evidence.]

The OpenAI project is recorded with an $8 hard spend limit, $8 available credit, and automatic recharge OFF; no worker API call had occurred at the checkpoint. [Hosted billing configuration/readback recorded; model execution unverified.]

Railway deployment `649268b7-e3e0-4f51-8299-abc01e94d922` is recorded for `hq-readiness-brief`; the process logged `disabled`, with one replica, no cron, restart NEVER, zero retries, and no public domain. [Hosted deployment/configuration recorded; successful worker operation unverified.]

The API key handoff remained outstanding, and the successful first cloud run requirements were an immutable source-linked draft, token usage, cost reservation, Postgres persistence, review stop, and authenticated-owner visibility. [Missing execution evidence.]

Neon pre-production migrations 0003 and 0004 are checksum-recorded, with separated runner and reader access and a redacted cloud snapshot; runner identity and spending policy were paused. [Locally/hosted setup recorded; operational validation unverified.]

The snapshot states that all A–G workstreams have charters/queues and reviewed initial internal outputs, but ongoing customer/distribution work is incomplete and six desktop schedules have not been cut over. [Initial internal work recorded; completion and replacement unverified.]

owner_hosted_readback: 2026-09-17T11:07Z: private owner access, database connected, saved draft in review, $0.05 held, pilot paused
state_after_run: Paused; no recurring schedule; review incomplete
